usage.callShape: POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/gpt-image-1.5/generate with JSON body {prompt} (optional: size, quality, background, output_format, output_compression, moderation). Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} with SIWX auth until status=complete.
usage.outputShape: POST returns body.jobId + body.status="pending". Poll body.status (pending|loading|complete) and body.progress; final image URL at body.result.imageUrl.
quirks: Registry surface price is $10.00 but the actual x402 quote/charge was only $0.13 USDC on Base.
Async two-step: POST /generate returns {success, jobId, status:'pending'} and does NOT return the image.

Poll the status at GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} — this endpoint is SIWX-gated (returns 402 'SIWX authentication required' without a wallet identity), but polling itself is FREE (no payment).
Status progresses pending -> loading (progress 10..70) -> complete (progress 100); completed in ~60s in test.
Final image is at body.result.imageUrl (a Vercel blob storage URL), NOT in the POST response.
usage.guide: Call POST https://stablestudio.dev/api/generate/gpt-image-1.5/generate with JSON {"prompt":"..."} (pay x402 USDC on Base; observed cost ~$0.13 despite the $10 registry display). You get back {success, jobId, status:"pending"}. Then poll GET https://stablestudio.dev/api/jobs/{jobId} using SIWX wallet auth (free) every several seconds until body.status === "complete". Read the finished image URL from body.result.imageUrl. Status can be pending/loading along the way with body.progress 0-100.
